summary: Scinai Immunotherapeutics filed a Form 6-K on September 8, 2026, announcing that its option and license arrangements with PinCell S.r.l. for the PC111 program concluded without extension. Options expired on August 31, 2026, and agreements terminated per their terms. No new negative scientific findings were cited; the company is refocusing capital on its NanoAb platform and CDMO business. No financial terms, board recommendations, or advisors were disclosed. This is a routine strategic update, not a special-situation transaction.
